basics.name: Cristhian Quiñonez Chiriboga
basics.label: Front-End Developer
basics.summary: My name is Cristhian Quiñonez, and I live in Madrid. About two years ago, I decided to switch from a career in cooking to the world of web development. I enrolled on an advanced diploma course in Web Application Development and completed it in June 2025. I am looking for an opportunity to learn, gain experience and, above all, devote all my time to developing projects.

work.summary: Development of interactive interfaces and reusable components using the Vue.js and Nuxt ecosystem.
highlights: Implementing scalable CSS architectures with SCSS.
Performance optimisation and technical SEO in Nuxt applications.
